k:堕.mnemonic: Those who have (有) everything stand on top of the mound (阝). One slip and he slides down into the soil (土), wallowing a little lower each day. Degenerate (descend to, lapse into).
k:堕.hint: Sliding from the hilltop into dirt.

k:擬.mnemonic: A mime's fingers (扌) trace an invisible wall so well that you doubt (疑) your own eyes. He copies the real thing exactly. Mimic (imitate, nominate).

k:赦.mnemonic: The judge raises his hand to strike (攵), sees the culprit's face turn red (赤) with shame, and lowers it again. Go home. Pardon (forgiveness).
k:赦.hint: The raised hand comes down gently.

k:婿.mnemonic: A woman (女) spends a month (月) sewing a wedding robe from a bolt (疋) of cloth. The man it is cut to fit is the one she will marry. Bridegroom (son-in-law).
k:婿.hint: A wedding robe cut to fit him.

k:升.mnemonic: A square wooden cup that holds a thousand (千) grains of rice. Twenty (廾) scoops fill a sack. It is the merchant's standard scoop. Measuring box (1.8 liter).

k:衡.mnemonic: Two farmers go (行) to weigh the harvest: a big (大) sack from the rice field (田) on one side, a cradle (勹) of weights on the other, until the beam hangs level. Equilibrium (measuring rod, scale).

k:戚.mnemonic: The small (小) baby will become (成) just like his kin, says grandmother, waving a divining rod (卜) over the crib: uncle's nose, auntie's temper. Relative (grieve, relatives).

k:醸.mnemonic: A wine jar (酉) is wrapped in a warm garment (衣) and left alone for six (六) weeks. Inside, rice and water quietly turn into drink. Brew (cause).

k:弔.mnemonic: A mourner unstrings his bow (弓) and plants it beside a stick (｜) of incense at the grave, head lowered. Condolences (mourning, funeral).
k:弔.hint: An unstrung weapon at a grave.

k:脊.mnemonic: A person (人) who carries heavy loads for a month (月) learns exactly which column of bones holds him upright. Spine (stature, height).
k:脊.hint: The column that holds you upright.

k:畔.mnemonic: A raised strip of earth cuts the rice field (田) in half (半) and holds the water in. Farmers walk along the top of it. Paddy ridge (levee).

k:蔽.mnemonic: A sparkle (⺌) would give the cash (幣) away, so you heap flowers (艹) over it until nothing shows. Conceal (cover, shade, mantle).

k:蛮.mnemonic: A wild man lifts the lid (亠) of his cooking pot and proudly offers you insect (虫) stew, to be eaten with the hands. Barbarian.

k:壌.mnemonic: Six (六) farmers each lay a garment (衣) on the soil (土) to mark out their share of the ground. Every coat covers one plot of earth. Lot (earth, soil, dirt).

k:柵.mnemonic: Tree (木) trunks stand upright side by side like the spines of a tome (冊) on a shelf, ringing the fort. Stockade (fence, weir, entwine around).
k:柵.hint: Trunks lined up like book spines.

k:蚕.mnemonic: An insect (虫) that spins a thread so fine it seems a gift from heaven (天). Emperors dressed in what it made. Silkworm.

k:顎.mnemonic: Every member (員) of the choir sings from the same page (頁), and beneath each face swings the hinged bone that holds the teeth like a cradle (勹). Jaw (chin, gill).

k:酌.mnemonic: The host holds the wine jar (酉) in the cradle (勹) of his arm and ladles a cup for each guest in turn. Bar-tending (serving sake, the host, ladle).

k:庸.mnemonic: Under the canopy (广) the day's task (用) never changes: a broom (ヨ) for the floor and a brush (聿) for the ledger. Nothing special, just a plain hired hand. Ordinary (commonplace, employment).

k:淫.mnemonic: A tsunami (氵) of desire: the samurai (士) forgets his duty to the king (王) and paws with a claw (爪) at every pretty face at court. Lewdness (licentiousness).

k:倣.mnemonic: The leader (亻) is about to release (放) his arrow, and every archer behind him copies the stance and lets fly the same way. Emulate (imitate).

k:溺.mnemonic: A weak (弱) swimmer is caught in a tsunami (氵): the water closes over his head and he flails for the lifeguard. Drown (indulge).

k:嫉.mnemonic: A woman (女) takes to her sickbed (疒), struck by an arrow (矢) of spite because her rival won the prize. It has made her ill. Envy (jealous).

k:罵.mnemonic: A horse (馬) caught in a net (罒) kicks and screams, and the trapper screams right back, hurling every rude name he knows. Abuse (curse, insult).
k:罵.hint: Trapper shouting at a tangled animal.

k:苛.mnemonic: 'You can (可) do better than these flowers (艹)!' The master picks at every petal the gardener grows, nagging without rest. Torment (scold, chastise).

k:弧.mnemonic: A bow (弓) fires a melon (瓜) into the sky. It rises, tips over and falls, tracing one smooth curve from start to splat. Arc (arch, bow).

k:睦.mnemonic: Two friends sit on the soil (土) with legs (儿) crossed, eye (目) to eye, chatting easily for hours. Intimate (friendly, harmonious).

k:肪.mnemonic: After a month (月) of feasting, his belly grows in every direction (方) and the buttons give up. Obese (fat).

k:壱.mnemonic: A samurai (士) signing a contract taps his forehead (冖) with a spoon (匕): a single plain stroke is too easy to forge, so write the number the long way. One (in documents).

k:帥.mnemonic: The general stands in the middle (中) of the army and waves a towel (巾) as his banner. Wherever it goes, the soldiers follow. Leading troops (commander, governor).
